scope: Built-in new-game setup (src/DeepFrontier/Scripts/MapSetup, docs/maps.md 'Built-in maps: new-game setup'). The per-map placements, total height, map size and unmet items come from tools/map_variants/*.json (each default variant whose source is builtin:<Name>). tools/map_setup_content.mjs generates Configurations/DeepFrontierMapSetup.blueprint.json and the enUS rows from this file and the variants; tools/prepare_deep_frontier_map.py builtin checks this file against the game and the reference variants.
devMapsWhy: The game's developer test maps (IsDev, empty loc keys; the new-game list shows them only in dev mode). Deep Frontier gives them no setup: a new game on one gets a notification and a log line saying so, and no objects or height. The names are their asset (GameObject) names in resources.assets; prepare_deep_frontier_map.py checks that the sizes match the game's dev maps.

smallMap.why: A built-in map is small when its area (width x height) is below maxArea. maxArea is derived, and checked by prepare_deep_frontier_map.py builtin: the largest area that the full-loop sites claim on a reference map (primary footprints plus their listed open margins, siteArea.withOpenMargins of the built-in validation) divided by landShare. Below it, those sites alone would take more than half of the map, before terrain, water, farms, forest and homes.

unmetText.why: Player-facing lines for a variant's declared unmet loop items (the variant's 'reason' stays in the JSON, the validation evidence and docs/maps.md). Every missing building site of a map is folded into one line, sites with the buildings' enUS display names; every other item needs its line here, and map_setup_content.mjs fails on an item without one.

items.shore fishing banks (first FreshFish): No natural shore-fishing banks: dam a river deeper before the Gatherer Flag can catch the first fish.
items.irrigated farmland near the start: Little irrigated farmland near the start.
items.Deep Drill sites beside Deep Ore Sources: No Deep Drill site beside a Deep Ore Source.
items.Human Record Caches in survey range of a: No Human Record Caches to survey.
